message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **federal holidays that create “long weekends”** in Canada for 2023.  
(“Long weekend” here means a holiday that falls on a Friday, Thursday, Monday, or Tuesday, giving you at least three consecutive days off when you take the adjacent weekday off.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Potential | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|------------------------|-------|
| **Good Friday** | April 7 | Friday | ✔ | Gives a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun). |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Monday | ✔ | Gives a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) if you take the preceding Friday off. |
| **Labour Day** | September 4 | Monday | ✔ | Gives a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) if you take the preceding Friday off. |
| **Thanksgiving** | October 9 | Monday | ✔ | Gives a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) if you take the preceding Friday off. |
| **Remembrance Day** | November 11 | Monday | ✔ | Gives a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) if you take the preceding Friday off. |
| **Christmas Day** | December 25 | Monday | ✔ | Gives a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) if you take the preceding Friday off. |
| **Boxing Day** | December 26 | Tuesday | ✔ | Gives a 4‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun‑Mon) if you take the preceding Friday off. |

### Holidays that fall on a weekend (no extra day off unless you take a weekday off)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------|
| New Year’s Day | January 1 | Sunday | No extra day off unless you take Monday off. |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, etc.) | February 20 | Monday | Already a holiday; gives a 3‑day weekend if you take the preceding Friday off. |
| Canada Day | July 1 | Saturday | No extra day off unless you take Monday off. |

> **Tip for your holiday‑planning app:**  
> - If you want to highlight *automatic* long weekends (i.e., the holiday itself is on a Friday or Thursday), only Good Friday qualifies.  
> - For *potential* long weekends (holiday on a Monday or Tuesday), you’ll need to let users decide whether they’ll take the adjacent weekday off.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like provincial holidays added or a more detailed breakdown!
